summary.title: Torch ABI mismatch: 7 unresolved c10 symbols
root_causes: Native extensions _C.abi3.so and _rocm_C.abi3.so linked against incompatible torch ABI: missing c10::MessageLogger::stream[abi:cxx11](), c10::TensorImpl::incref_pyobject(), c10::TensorImpl::decref_pyobject(), and c10::hip::c10_hip_check_implementation() symbols
vLLM 0.19.1.dev3+rocm7.13.0 wheel built with torch version mismatched to runtime torch 2.9.1+rocm7.13.0
summary.recommended_action: Rebuild vLLM native extensions against torch 2.9.1+rocm7.13.0, or use a pre-built wheel compiled with the same torch version.

deterministic_fallback.title: Blocked by torch ABI mismatch
root_causes: 7 torch ABI symbol(s) unresolved, e.g. c10::MessageLogger::stream[abi:cxx11]()
deterministic_fallback.recommended_action: Pair the vLLM wheel with the torch build its native extensions were linked against (same ROCm version), or rebuild the extensions.
